svg.title: Camera mounts, aiming and remaining blind areas
svg.desc: Brigade BE-890C 2871E packaging candidate; ideal geometric coverage only; real images, dirt, night and delay still need tests.. Dimensioned review geometry. Fabrication unreleased.
svg.text: Camera mounts, aiming and remaining blind areas
Brigade BE-890C 2871E packaging candidate; ideal geometric coverage only; real images, dirt, night and delay still need tests.
Lens: X300 / Y0 / Z1800; forward −X; aim 20° down.
Rail bridge: 180 ×632.4 ×12 on rail top Z1454.8.
Clean from a verified standing position. Hood has no crossbar ahead of
the lens; cleaning reach and impact protection remain to be tested.
Lens: coach X9100 / Y350 / Z2200; aft +X; aim 20° down.
Two frame clamp plates: 8 ×180 ×140; mast support held.
Clean by a retained tilt/removal system from a protected rear-platform
position. Tilt support, retention and safe access are not yet designed.
Camera box 86 W ×80 D ×72 H; own adapter 100 ×110 ×6, four Ø7 on 60 ×70; OEM hole pattern held. Mount details schematic.
CAB-C2-V01 · 22 October 2026 · dimensions in mm · review / fabrication unreleased
